name: beads-design
description: Embroidery design store: React website (client/) served by an Express API (server/), one Node app

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "cross-env PORT=5000 node --watch server/src/index.js" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
